text: Fresh full three-file invalidation change read. MaybeDeleteMessageFromStore checks the required header pointer, returns success when Offline is absent, deletes stored bytes when present and clears only the Offline flag using an inverted mask. The Rust Update path calls it after header population and before CommitChanges; immediate redownload is explicitly deferred. The method name retains Maybe because non-offline is a successful no-op. Current shared ExchangeMessageSyncHandler::OnMessageUpdated performs invalidation inside the update callback, preserves other flags, applies metadata/notifies listeners and commits. The separate current folder integration test first downloads the old body and stores its token, changes remote body/subject, syncs, then reads a new greeting and a different token. These are direct source assertions, not executed results. Callback redesign was agreed future work, not part of this landing.
title: EWS message updates invalidate offline content before committing metadata
